RESEARCH VERDICT

Verdict: caution
Risk: high
Confidence: 0.70
Rationale: Research weakens the buy case: FY26 cash generation is filing-supported, but unverified screen TTM FCF, a rolling Sep-Q price and a ~A$2.7bn FY27–29 growth spend make the FCF-yield signal cyclically fragile.
RiskTags: cyclical, competitive, leverage

The screen signal is buy; `adjusted_signal` in the 30 Oct 2026 snapshot is also buy (not a downgrade). Overlay tensions that remain open: Yahoo quarterly cash flow is empty, so screen TTM FCF of 800,153,600 (snapshot `auto_fallback_screen_ttm`) is unverified; FCF Yield passed on that unverified TTM, not on a filing cash-flow statement; the cyclical overlay did not fire despite lithium price swings in the filings; Piotroski “positive operating cash flow” failed on empty TTM data even though FY26 filings show a large cash margin. Dividend-family models (High Dividend Yield, Dividend Growth) did **not** pass, so there is no “yield pass vs cover <1.0×” conflict: the FY26 final of ~$161M is ~22% of company-defined adjusted free cash flow (cover well above 1.0×). No interim was paid in H1 FY26; that is a skip under the capital-management framework, not a flagged cut of a paid interim. Yahoo FY26 revenue of 1,539,710,000 (financials_annual.json) is below filing revenue of $1,934M; NPAT aligns ($525.761M vs $526M). Prefer filings. Yahoo FY26 FCF of 1,020,354,000 is close to filing cash margin $1,357M less capex $328M (≈$1,029M) but is still a Yahoo annual figure, not TTM.

COMPARISON EVIDENCE

EVIDENCE
- [filings/bodies/b830a4c9aebe5908.txt] "Revenue $1,934M (up 152% on FY25): 17% sales growth and 121% increase in average estimated realised price." — FY26 earnings recovery is price-led; this is the year the screen FCF Yield pass is harvesting, not a steady-state run-rate.
- [filings/bodies/b830a4c9aebe5908.txt] "this represents a dividend pay out ratio of ~2 2% of FY26 adjusted free cash flow14." — FY26 final (~$161M, 5cps) is conservatively covered on the company’s adjusted-FCF definition; dividend-family screens did not pass, so cover is not a screen/filing clash.
- [filings/bodies/928ce56ce0b52368.txt] "The Board of PLS did not declare a final dividend payment for FY25 in line with the Company’s Capital Management Framework and to preserve balance sheet strength." — FY25 statutory loss and withheld dividend show how quickly distributions and earnings drop when lithium prices fall.
- [filings/bodies/c664bba741782680.txt] "No interim dividend has been declared, consistent with the Company’s capital management framework and priority to preserve balance sheet strength and financial flexibility through the cycle." — H1 FY26 paid no interim; snapshot `interim_dividend_cut_flagged` is false; this is a skip, not a cut of a paid interim.
- [filings/bodies/ea1b43c0732c2a00.txt] "The P2000 FS supports investment of approximately A$1.9 billion (B) in P2000" — Committed growth capex (plus A$600–650M enhancing infrastructure and ~A$150M PPA connection) will absorb FY26-style FCF through FY29.
- [filings/bodies/c09f130d76138950.txt] "Revenue of $563M was 24% lower, reflecting a lower average estimated realised price and sales volumes affected by shipment timing, partly offset by favourable FX movements." — Sep-Q FY27 already rolls realised price and revenue off the FY26 peak the screen is using.
- [filings/bodies/ea1b43c0732c2a00.txt] "While the long-term outlook remains supportive, lithium markets are expected to remain cyclical, reinforcing the importance of low -cost, long-life and reliable supply through the cycle." — Issuer acknowledges cyclicality; the screen’s cyclical overlay did not flag it.

NUMBERS
- Net profit/(loss) after tax | $M 526 | FY26 | [filings/bodies/b830a4c9aebe5908.txt]
- Cash margin from operations | $M 1,357 | FY26 | [filings/bodies/b830a4c9aebe5908.txt]
- Capex | $M 328 | FY26 | [filings/bodies/b830a4c9aebe5908.txt]
- Free Cash Flow | 1020354000.0 | FY2026 Yahoo annual (TTM suppressed; not filing-aligned) | [financials_annual.json]
- P2000 project capital | approximately A$1.9 billion (B) | P2000 FID, 16 Oct 2026 | [filings/bodies/ea1b43c0732c2a00.txt]
- Capex | A$M 1,130 – 1,195 | FY27 guidance | [filings/bodies/c09f130d76138950.txt]

THESIS BREAKS
- Realised spodumene prices remaining at or below FY26 FOB unit cost ($569/t) for a sustained period while P2000, enhancing infrastructure and PPA connection spend is already committed.
- FY27 operating cash flow failing to cover guided capex of A$1,130–1,195M, forcing dilutive equity or a breach of the stated capital-management framework.
- A restated P2000 study showing incremental NPV is negative at then-prevailing SC6 prices rather than the US$1,620/t consensus used at FID.
- Return to an FY25-style statutory loss with the restored 5cps dividend cancelled or cut.
